text: THE DBIM DESIGN'S OUR PERFORMANCE SHOWS THE DEPARTMENT'S DASHBOARDS, AND THE PM-AJAY DASHBOARD MOVES TO THE PM-AJAY PAGE. On the Department's instruction, Ministry › Our Performance carries the Department's own dashboards — the live site's Beneficiary Dashboard (dosje.gov.in/dashboard) first, then Social Audit — and no longer a PM-AJAY tile. The PM-AJAY dashboard is the scheme's, so it is drawn on the PM-AJAY page under Our Scheme Portals, full width below the page's text, as the 2026 design keeps its PM-AJAY dashboards on the organisation's pages. `/dashboard`, which on dosje.gov.in is the Beneficiary Dashboard, now opens Our Performance.
